notes.title: Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
Fixes and improvements were made to the game based on player feedback.

[b] New Features [/b]

Translation options for Portuguese, Spanish, Chinese and Russian were added.

[b] Bug fixes [/b]

Backgrounds are no longer static.
The backgrounds have been styled to be more beautiful.
Now just press the mouse to continue shooting.
Improved game song repetition.
Blur removed from menu.

[b] Bug fixes [/b]

Fixed bug where the achievement "Beater" could not be earned.
